rows.definition: cachevaluereport.CacheReadFraction is the share of prompt tokens the provider served from its prompt cache (cache_read / prompt_tokens), surfaced in the cache-value audit row and the TUI savings overview.
rows.distinction: It is the realized READ FRACTION the provider reported, not CacheableTokens (the lookup-side eligibility count that could have been served) and not the KV cache (local tensor storage).

rows.definition: internal/cachesweep (the package) and `fak cachesweep` (the verb) reap stale or orphaned cache artifacts the dispatcher and session layers leave behind, bounded by a lane-aware scan so a sweep never touches a live session's working set.
rows.distinction: It is a HOUSEKEEPING verb that deletes stale cache artifacts, not the KV cache (live tensor storage) and not cachemeta (the metadata contract it may reap expired entries from).

rows.definition: gateway.FakCompactionCacheReadTokens is the OBSERVED provider cache_read token count at a session's compaction point - the tokens the provider evidenced as cache_reads, surfaced in cache_pricing and the /debug/vars attribution block.
rows.distinction: It is the COMPACTION-POINT observed read count, not CacheableTokens (the lookup-side eligibility) and not CacheReadFraction (the ratio derived from it).

rows.definition: gatewayusageledger.CacheTTLUpgradesUpgraded (with CacheTTLUpgradeReasons) is the usage-ledger counter pair recording how many times the managed-cache posture AUTHORED a 1h-TTL upgrade of a stable prefix (wrote ttl:1h into the outbound body) and why, surfaced in the weekly cache-value report. It counts fak AUTHORING, NOT the provider ACCEPTING: on a subscription-OAuth seat the provider 400s the 1h body, so a nonzero count there is a crash signal, not realized 1h caching.
rows.distinction: It is the LEDGER COUNTER of upgrade events, not guardManagedCacheOn (the "on" literal the posture switches on) and not ManagedCacheVars (the /debug/vars struct that reports the current posture).

rows.definition: internal/dispatchcache is the per-lane dispatch result cache that memoizes a dispatch tick's issue-to-worker routing decisions so a re-tick does not recompute the full pairwise scan, backed by a bounded queue and a backlog.
rows.distinction: It is a DISPATCH-ROUTING memoization cache, not the KV cache (inference tensor storage) and not cachemeta (the metadata contract for reusable inference entries).

rows.definition: memq's MiniCache (#4018) is the opt-in divergence-outlier exemption that carves the top-K most-divergent cells out of a lossy fold set before the fold, keeping them bit-exact so the most information-dense cells survive a lossy compression step.
rows.distinction: It is a MEMQ lossy-fold exemption strategy, not the KV cache (inference tensor storage) and not vCache (the provider prefix-cache control plane).

rows.definition: compute.ReplayKVCacheMulti replays every requested KVEvictPolicy against an offline KV-replay event trace and scores each by realized reuse under a token budget, the oracle behind the kvreplay benchmark and the expert-residency LFU comparison.
rows.distinction: It is the OFFLINE REPLAY function that scores eviction policies, not the KV cache (the live tensor storage the policies would evict from) and not CacheSample (a periodic metrics scrape).

rows.definition: metrics.CacheBreakEvent is the struct type for one witnessed cache-prefix break - the cause, the token cost, and the event count - produced by WitnessCacheBreak and accumulated into a CacheBreakReport via FoldCacheBreaks.
rows.distinction: It is the single-event RECORD TYPE, not CacheBurstBreakEvenTurns (the pricing function that decides whether a burst repays) and not the prompt cache (the provider feature whose prefix was broken).

rows.definition: metrics.CacheBreakReport is the per-session operator readout folded from the session's witnessed CacheBreakEvent slice by FoldCacheBreaks, surfaced via the gateway's cacheBreakReport() accessor.
rows.distinction: It is the FOLDED REPORT struct, not CacheBreakEvent (the single-event type it folds from) and not CacheBurstBreakEvenTurns (the break-even pricing function).

rows.definition: CacheState is the free-text per-session cache-warmth label ("cold" / "warm-prefix" / "l3-shared" / "stable" / "mutated" / "unknown") surfaced in cmd/fak info, the provenance run manifest, and the scorecardpane context-status renderer.
rows.distinction: It is the FREE-TEXT warmth label a caller reports, not CachePosture (the observed warm/cold/managed session label) and not the KV cache (the storage the label describes).

rows.definition: gateway.CacheTTL5m ("5m") is the const pinning the default ephemeral provider cache tier - the 5-minute TTL window a prefix lives at when the managed-cache posture is OFF or auto-unupgraded, mirrored by the ablate package and the warm-resume scale-to-zero path.
rows.distinction: It is the 5-MINUTE TTL TIER constant, not CacheTTL1h (the upgraded 1-hour tier the managed-cache posture drives toward) and not DefaultVCacheAnchor (the star-anchor gate default).

rows.definition: dispatchtick.DuplicateRiskCache memoizes the last duplicate-risk issue-number scan result so a dispatch re-tick does not recompute the pairwise duplicate scan, held as a long-lived singleton in cmd/fak/dispatch_tick_route.go.
rows.distinction: It is a DISPATCH-DEDUP memoization cache, not dispatchcache (the per-lane routing-result cache) and not the KV cache (inference tensor storage).

rows.definition: The FAK_CACHEVALUE_* prefix is the env-var and Prometheus-metrics namespace for the cache-value reporting surface: FAK_CACHEVALUE_*_PER_MTOK_USD env overrides for per-MTok pricing, and the fak_cachevalue_* metrics family for the cache-value gauge and ablation expositions.
rows.distinction: It is the ENV/METRICS NAMESPACE for cache-value reporting, not CacheAttributionVars (the /debug/vars struct for the owner/plane split) and not ManagedCacheVars (the managed-cache posture block).

rows.definition: The fak_gateway_inference_cached_prompt_tokens_total Prometheus counter is the normalized, provider-agnostic count of prompt (input) tokens the upstream PROVIDER served from its own prompt cache across served turns, reading 0 on the in-kernel path (no provider).
rows.distinction: It is the PROVIDER-SIDE cache_read token counter, not CacheableTokens (the fak-side eligibility count) and not the KV cache (local tensor storage that needs no provider).

rows.definition: agent.messageHasCacheControlForElide reports whether a tool_result block's content array carries a cache_control breakpoint at ANY nesting depth, the deep variant the elision shrinker needs because it can reach nested tool_result content.
rows.distinction: It is the DEEP, any-depth detector the elision shrinker uses, not messageHasCacheControl (the shallow, one-level variant the compaction guards use) and not rawHasCacheControl (the raw-bytes predicate both wrap).

rows.definition: The prefix cache is the provider-side (vLLM / SGLang) or fak in-kernel (RadixKV) prefix-reuse cache observed via prefix_cache_hit_rate / prefix_cache_{queries,hits} metrics, the concept behind the webbench parity benchmark and the quality/prefix_cache.go parity child.
rows.distinction: It is the PROVIDER-OR-KERNEL prefix-reuse concept observed via metrics, not the KV cache (the raw tensor storage it indexes into) and not the prompt cache (the Anthropic cache_control breakpoint mechanism).

rows.definition: cachevaluereport.ProviderPromptCacheTokenEq (and ProviderPromptCacheTokenEquiv) is the token-equivalence count of provider-side prompt-cache savings - the tokens the provider's cache_read saved, normalized for the cache-value report's fleet-benefit track.
rows.distinction: It is the PROVIDER-SIDE savings token-equivalence, not CacheableTokens (the eligibility count) and not FakCompactionCacheReadTokens (the raw compaction-point read count).

rows.definition: agent.toolResultContentHasCacheControl reports whether a tool_result block's content array carries a cache_control breakpoint, the detector the elision shrinker and stale-span marker use alongside rawHasCacheControl.
rows.distinction: It is the TOOL_RESULT-CONTENT detector, not messageHasCacheControl (the shallow message-level detector) and not messageHasCacheControlForElide (the deep any-depth variant).

rows.definition: kvcached is the external kernel-module-level KV-cache management tool studied in BORROW-KVCACHED-STUDY-2026-07-10 for its in_shrink guard (where available_size() floors to prevent reclaim storms), referenced as a prior-art anchor in dispatchtick's predictive preflight.
rows.distinction: It is an EXTERNAL prior-art tool studied for borrow, not the KV cache (fak's own tensor storage) and not vCache (fak's virtual cache control plane).
